description: Geographic entities comprising countries and territories, first-level administrative divisions outside the United States, and US states, counties, cities/places, and Zipcodes. The type property distinguishes geographic kinds.

common_properties.name: identifier
common_properties.description: Geographic identifier: ISO2:<ISO2> for countries; GEONAMES.ADMIN1:<admin1_code> for GeoNames divisions; USZIP:<state_abbr>-<zip>, USPLACE:<place_geoid>, USCOUNTY:<county_geoid>, or USSTATE:<state_fips> for US geography. Outside-city-limits pseudo-city identifiers append the raw Zipcode to the place GEOID without a separator.

common_properties.name: name
common_properties.description: Geographic name; GeoNames divisions use the ASCII name. For US Zipcodes, the name is the raw five-digit Zipcode string.

common_properties.name: type
common_properties.description: Geographic kind: Country, Division, Zipcode, City, County, or State.

common_properties.name: last_updated
common_properties.description: Date and time the location was created or last changed.

common_properties.name: iso3
common_properties.description: ISO3 country code on Country locations: from GeoNames for non-US countries and territories, and USA from UnitedStatesZipcode_database for the United States. Missing GeoNames values are empty strings.

source_contributions.scope: Countries and territories except ISO2 US, and first-level administrative divisions except US.*. US territories with their own ISO2 codes, such as AS, GU, PR, and VI, are included.
source_contributions.description: Provides countries/territories and their first-level administrative divisions.

properties.name: code
properties.description: On Division locations, the part of the administrative division code after the dot; for example, 01 from DE.01.

source_contributions.scope: US Zipcodes, cities/places with Zipcode overlap, counties, states, and the United States country. Places with no entry in the Zipcode/place overlap data are excluded.
source_contributions.description: Provides the US geographic hierarchy. City locations include Outside city limits pseudo-cities, which have no City-to-County containment relationship. Zipcodes may have a KWG linkout.

properties.name: zipcode_type
properties.description: Zipcode category, such as STANDARD, PO BOX, or UNIQUE; absent if missing.

properties.name: state
properties.description: Two-letter state abbreviation on Zipcode locations; absent if missing.

properties.name: latitude
properties.description: Approximate latitude of a Zipcode; absent if missing or blank.

properties.name: longitude
properties.description: Approximate longitude of a Zipcode; absent if missing or blank.

properties.name: Linkout
properties.description: HTML anchor linking a Zipcode to its KWG zipCodeArea resource, with state-Zipcode anchor text such as TX-79934; absent if no mapping exists.

properties.name: city_fips
properties.description: Place FIPS-like code on City locations; empty string for Outside city limits pseudo-cities and otherwise absent if missing.

properties.name: state_name
properties.description: State name on City and County locations; absent if missing.

properties.name: state_fips
properties.description: State FIPS code on City and County locations; absent if missing.

properties.name: county_fips
properties.description: County FIPS-like code on County locations; absent if missing.

properties.name: abbr
properties.description: State abbreviation on State locations; absent if missing.
